name: Dual-incomer normally-open bus tie
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Shows two source-fed sections separated by a tie that is normally open.
description: Shows two source-fed sections separated by a tie that is normally open. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two incoming supplies” at the input and “Separated operating sections” at the output. Tie closing can create a source-parallel condition.
